about: Starts registered by the pre-registration of TIME-AS-FOLD-20261125-001A. Stars: one list of distinction labels per start knot; distinctions are named by their labels in increasing order (FD 2.1). The 227 starts are those of the census of RING-IN-BALANCE-20261123-001B that have a return giving parts off under its two added rules (its p3_census_detail.json, law "two"); "atlas_index" and "loose" are that census's keys, the stars its census_stars(atlas_index, loose): one shared distinction for each pair of knots that meet, in sorted pair order, then the loose distinctions of knot 0, knot 1, .... Weighting: each start once up to isomorphism (assumption A238).
